run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile aprime_smooth.py test_aprime_smooth.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; sha256sum aprime_smooth.py test_aprime_smooth.py aleph-fig5.json | tee /out/sha256.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python aprime_smooth.py --fetch-only --emuframe /work/emuframe.py > /out/fetch.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fetch.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_aprime_smooth > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python aprime_smooth.py --fig5 aleph-fig5.json --emuframe /work/emuframe.py --out /out --ntoys 10000 --workers 2 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/run.txt; exit $rc
